After finding Brother Tosai, you decide not to drink from his Chalice

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Bring the [[Chalice of Corruption]] to the [[Imperial Agent Hanjo]].

===Reward===
* 3,500 [[Experience]]
* 275 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Just speak with [[Imperial Agent Hanjo]] in [[Kaineng Center]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Brother Tosai'''
:''"Are you here to accept the truth of your own flesh? You can become so much more if you dare drink from the Chalice of Corruption...."''
::[[File:Tango-quest-icon.png]] ''"[[Drink from the Chalice of Corruption]]"''
::[[File:Tango-quest-icon.png]] ''"Refuse to Drink"''

After choosing "Refuse to Drink":

'''Brother Tosai'''
:''"I detect hesitation. Why do you back away? Will you drink from the '''Chalice''' or will you not? What is your intention?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'm taking this to Imperial Agent Hanjo, immediately!
|decline = I need some time to consider.
|ask = Unworthy infidel! The gods will strike you down for this betrayal of their gift! You will not escape their wrath forever! 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Imperial Agent Hanjo'''
:''"So, this Chalice is the secret of their immunity to the plague, eh? I cannot tell you enough how grateful the emperor will be to learn of this, and of your part obtaining it. I will turn it over to the emperor's personal advisers and scholars. Perhaps they can determine its properties. In the meantime, steer clear of [[Am Fah]]. No doubt they will be looking for you."''

==Notes==
* Accepting this quest will turn all the surrounding Am Fah hostile.
* When the Am Fah become hostile, you can just [[map travel]] to Kaineng Center to see Imperial Agent Hanjo for your reward. 
* Once this quest is completed, your character can no longer complete the [[Drink from the Chalice of Corruption]] quest.
* Upon turning hostile, many of the Am Fah, especially the [[Am Fah Marksman|Marksmen]] will fall victim to the numerous traps they set while friendly.
